full_prompt_en: An intricate pen-and-ink technical cartoon depicts an imaginary chain-reaction tower on a cream drafting sheet. A narrow central framework rises from a long horizontal base, supporting several stacked platforms crowded with small wheels, belts, drums, cranks, little vessels, and tiny operators. Two broad curved tracks sweep around the structure at different heights; their looping arcs give the otherwise upright composition a playful movement from side to side. The highest platform ends beneath a delicate pointed canopy. Fine arrows, dotted travel paths, leader lines, and faint handwritten labels hover around individual components, hinting at a complicated sequence without asking the viewer to decode every step. Thin black lines distinguish rods and cables, while darker hatch clusters and overlapping contours weight the central supports and crowded lower level. Much of the paper remains open around the machine, so its dense tiny marks retain a clear silhouette. The palette is almost entirely warm off-white and charcoal black, with a soft gray wash beneath the base and slight tan aging in the sheet. There is little naturalistic lighting; depth comes from nested linework, slight tonal accumulation, and tiny shadows under each shelf. A faint rectangular border and pale construction lines reinforce the look of an annotated invention drawing. The large looping track at right counters the small clutter at left, and the broad stable foot anchors the rising, eccentric apparatus. The mood is clever and gently absurd, precise at a glance yet full of unexpected, hand-drawn detours.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅繁密的钢笔墨线技术漫画在奶油色制图纸上描绘一座幻想连锁装置塔。狭窄中央框架从长长的水平底座升起，承托几层叠起的平台，上面挤着小轮、皮带、鼓轮、曲柄、小容器和微型操作人。两道宽阔弯轨在不同高度绕过结构；盘旋弧线使原本竖直的构图左右流动，带着玩笑感。最高平台停在纤巧尖顶篷下。细箭头、虚点行进路线、引线和浅淡手写标签飘在各部件周围，暗示复杂步骤，却不要求观者逐步解码。细黑线区分杆与缆，较暗的排线簇和叠压轮廓加重中央支架及拥挤底层。机器周围保留大面积空纸，因此密集细小笔痕仍形成清晰剪影。调色几乎全是暖米白与炭黑，底座下有柔灰罩染，纸张略带褐色旧痕。这里几乎没有自然主义照明；空间感来自嵌套线稿、轻微的调子累积，以及各层架子下面的小阴影。浅淡矩形边框与淡施工线强化带注释发明图的样貌。右边的大环轨抵消左侧的细小杂物，宽稳的底脚锚住不断上升的古怪装置。气氛机智且温和荒诞，第一眼精确，又充满手绘的意外绕路。
style_prompt_en: Fine pen-and-ink drawing combines precise technical construction lines with the loose wit of an old explanatory cartoon. Charcoal marks on warm off-white paper carry nearly the entire image; pale gray shading and slight tan aging add restrained depth. Hairline rods, dotted paths, arrows, leader strokes, and tiny handwritten annotation textures create dense local information, while generous unmarked margins preserve overall legibility. An upright stacked silhouette is steadied by a broad low base and enlivened by sweeping looped arcs across its sides. Crosshatching gathers at junctions and under horizontal layers, with lighter broken lines allowed to fade into the paper. Spatial depth is diagrammatic rather than atmospheric, and illumination remains even, without strong highlights or cast shadows. Faint border lines and visible drafting irregularities maintain the sense of a carefully imagined, handmade sheet. The visual rhythm alternates crowded miniature clusters with calm cream openings, leaving a playful impression of rigorous invention just beyond comprehension.
style_prompt_zh: 细钢笔墨线画把精确技术施工线与旧式说明漫画的松弛机智结合。炭黑笔迹落在暖米白纸上，几乎承载整幅画；浅灰明暗与轻微褐色旧痕带来克制的深度。发丝般杆线、虚点路径、箭头、引导笔触与微小手写标注纹理构成局部密度，宽大的未着墨边缘维持整体易读。竖直叠层的剪影由宽低底座稳定，两侧掠过的回环弧线使其活跃。交叉排线聚在连接处和水平层下，较轻的断续线可淡入纸面。空间深度偏图解式而非空气透视，光线保持均匀，没有强烈高光或投影。浅边框和可见的制图不规则感维持精心想象的手工纸页气息。视觉节奏在拥挤微型簇与平静奶油空处间交替，留下严谨发明却又难以彻底参透的玩味印象。
theme_en: An elaborate imaginary chain-reaction tower on a cream drafting sheet
theme_zh: 奶油色制图纸上一座繁复的幻想连锁装置塔
name: Rube Goldberg
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
